name: Avoid undocumented Routines (Rexx)
description: This quality rule reports all routines with no comments.
output:
This rule lists all undocumented Routines.
It provides the following information:
- Routines full name
rationale: Maintainability of the code is facilitated if there is documentation in the code. This rule will ensure there are comments within the Routines.
reference:
CWE-1053: Missing Documentation for Design
https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/1053.html

Carnegie Mellon's Software Engineering Institute on Cyclomatic Complexity
http://www.sei.cmu.edu/reports/95cm028.pdf

NIST (National Institute of Standards and Technology)
Structured Testing: A Testing Methodology Using the Cyclomatic Complexity Metric
https://www.nist.gov/publications/structured-testing-testing-methodology-using-cyclomatic-complexity-metric
remediation: Add comments into routines to explain what is their goal and how they work.
alternativeName: Make sure to explain the goal, objective that a function achieves to improve its maintainability
